name: Succubus

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Power from Pain: Flensing Fury
bonuses.text: If this Threat deals a Wound it gains +3 bonus dice to Weapon Skill (I) Tests until the end of its next Turn.

bonuses.name: Obsession: Precise Killer
bonuses.text: If this Threat makes an All Out Attack, the AP value of their melee weapons increases by 1 for that attack.

abilities.name: Torturous Acrobatics
abilities.text: The Succubus moves to their target then uses a Multi-Action to make an Athletics (S) Interaction Attack attempting to make them Vulnerable, followed by a melee attack with their Archite Glaive.

abilities.name: Brides of Death
abilities.text: All Wyches within 5 metres of the Succubus gain +2 bonus dice to any Weapon Skill (I) Tests until the end of the Succubus' next Turn.

abilities.name: No Escape
abilities.text: When this Threat makes a Reaction Attack with a melee weapon they do so with +2 bonus dice.

determination: Lightning Dodge: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 4d6. This Threat uses Agility instead of Toughness to roll Determination., and can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.
note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (Champion with 2 personal Ruin but only 5 Wounds). Inflict (Poisoned) prints no number. Determination text has a printed stray full stop and comma, copied.
